purpose: Re-prove the four element-7 target-bounded sites at the b78 candidate after the b77 register-closure witnesses stopped re-deriving.  One row is resolved by a derived table-cursor proof; one is left target-bounded with the facts that would be needed to bound it.

rows.decision_basis: the b77 witness was over-fitted to b77 codegen.  It required the constructor's %rsi to close to exactly `ossl_any_to_obj_algorithm`; at b78 the row pointer is spilled to 0x10(%rsp), reloaded after a clobber, and advanced by `lea 0x20(%r13),%r13`, so the exact-base closure has roots=[] even though the only possible origin of the argument is still the named table.

new_proof.uniqueness: the row's slot read (+0x30) is performed by exactly one indirect transfer in file_load, and the register derivation admits exactly one root

rows.census_row: DECODER_METHOD_SITES 0x24dfed re-derives through the in-symbol witness search (no-candidate-transfer-is-accepted-by-the-witness before the repair)

rows.decision_basis: same over-fit as 0x2cc9aa: the argument is the loop-carried row pointer, not the literal table base.

new_proof.uniqueness: the row's slot read (+0x50) is performed by exactly one indirect transfer in file_load

rows.decision_basis: same over-fit as 0x2cc9aa: the argument is the loop-carried row pointer, not the literal table base.

new_proof.uniqueness: the row's slot read (+0x38) is performed by exactly one indirect transfer in file_load

rows.decision_basis: the code shape is a CONF-method dispatch, not a store-loader close guard: the operand is `DEFAULT_CONF_METHOD.0->destroy` (load from the static slot 0x8ac1e0 followed by +0x10) inside the inlined `NCONF_free` tail of X509V3_EXT_REQ_add_conf, and the receiver is the CONF built by `NCONF_new_ex` at 0x49a841.  The earlier b78 note describing this row as a store-loader closefn polarity arm is wrong: the store-loader legacy rows are contract-bounded at this candidate (ABI_CONTRACT_STORE_LOADER = 3).
rows.why_not_bounded: no admitted witness owns an out-of-module CONF-method dispatch.  `conf_module_witness` is pinned to CONF_SITES inside the CONF module's own functions and requires the `%r15`/`%rax` operand with a `%r12` base; this site is in another symbol, reads the method from the default-method global, and passes its receiver in `%rbx`.
what_a_sound_witness_needs: pin the site by (symbol leaf X509V3_EXT_REQ_add_conf, offset 0xbc) and refuse a moved row unless exactly one transfer in the symbol is accepted

prove the operand load is +0x10 of the method object and that offset is the `destroy` member of the source CONF_METHOD layout (the existing CONF_OWNER layout machinery would need a CONF_METHOD layout owner)

prove the method object is the process default CONF method, whose writer set includes the public CONF_set_default_method (0x29b3d0) -- i.e. the callback is application-supplied by a documented ABI, which is what makes the class contract-bounded
record that DEFAULT_CONF_METHOD.0 also carries defensive self-writes (mov %rax,0x8ac1e0) and one initialiser store (0x8295d0), so a 'closed static table' claim would be wrong for this slot

controls.positive: the admitted image's constructor argument derives from ossl_any_to_obj_algorithm with a 0x20 row stride and a terminator guard
controls.stride_mutation: an extent that is not a whole multiple of the observed advance (extent + 5) refuses
controls.root_mutation: moving the table root in the instruction stream makes the derivation stop matching the enumerated table
controls.constructor_mutation: DECODER_METHOD_CONSTRUCTOR replaced by a leaf that names no function start refuses (constructor-not-enumerated)
controls.slot_mutation: perturbing one row's read offset by +8 refuses (read-field-not-enumerated)
controls.restore: after every mutation all three rows are accepted again
controls.pre_existing_repin_controls: the b77 pin/search controls still run; three pre-existing self-test failures remain (see does_not_prove[2])

does_not_prove: the table-cursor derivation does not prove the walk terminates inside the table's four rows.  It proves the argument is derived only from `ossl_any_to_obj_algorithm` by whole-row advances, and requires the loop's continuation to be a zero test of a row field (the table's own terminator).  A source-level proof that the loop cannot over-run the terminated table is NOT established by this witness.

the derivation does not prove that the table rows' function pointers are the only writers of the OsslDecoder slots by itself; it relies on the existing writer gate (`_led_source_gate`, types.OsslDecoder == PASS), which is unchanged.

pre-existing self-test failures at this candidate are NOT fixed or newly caused by this change.  Baseline (tool d3d01dfe) failed with 7 entries; this change leaves 6 of them and removes 'e7repin: 3 pinned row(s) neither re-derive by offset nor resolve by witness search'.  The six that remain are the e7repin-search guard/polarity controls (2 of them disable-the-search negatives), the e7core default-context NOT_RUN, and the e7store guard mutation controls (2).  None is in the touched rules, and none was fixed here.
the residual site 0x49a8dc is not bounded, so element 7 remains FAIL at this candidate and no closure receipt may be produced from this run.

the decoder rows are bounded as ABI_CONTRACT_DECODER_METHOD_OBJECT for the *argument provenance* property only; that is one of element 7's contract classes, not a family discharge (AGENTS.md section 7 SAFE_COMPATIBLE).
non_claims: this file is not a closure receipt and does not change any obligation's state
no boundary receipt was edited to make a row bind
the b78 closure receipts (evidence/closure-{ssh,sshd}-b78.json) are superseded only by a future accepted closure produced with the repaired tool
